    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06b" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="End_NoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="Task_ClosePaid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ClosePaid" targetRef="End_PaidClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToCollectionDispute" targetRef="End_CollectionForwarded"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Subrogation" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/subrogation">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subrogation" name="Subrogation recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Handler" name="Recourse handler" processRef="Process_Subrogation"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CollectionAgency" name="Collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Msg_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DisagreementReceived" name="Disagreement received" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" messageRef="Msg_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ForwardCaseDisagreement" name="Case forwarded" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToCollectionDisagreement" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency" messageRef="Msg_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ForwardCaseDeadline" name="Case forwarded" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToCollectionDeadline" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency" messageRef="Msg_ForwardCase"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DisagreementReceived" name="Disagreement received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ForwardCase" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subrogation" name="Subrogation Recourse Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PotentialSubrogation" name="Potential subrogation case arises">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInfo" name="Obtain subrogation information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Recourse possible?" default="Flow_05">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to insurant" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateReminder" name="Create reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitResponse" name="Await insurant response or disagreement deadline">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Msg_PaymentReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DisagreementReceived" messageRef="Msg_DisagreementReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeadlineReached" name="Disagreement deadline reached">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration of the disagreement deadline is not specified in the description.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BookPayment" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClosePaid" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaidClosed" name="Case closed after payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check insurant's reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" name="Insurant reasoning correct?" default="Flow_17">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAgreed" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgreedClosed" name="Case closed after insurant was right">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardToCollectionDisagreement" name="Forward case to collection agency" messageRef="Msg_ForwardCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardToCollectionDeadline" name="Forward case to collection agency" messageRef="Msg_ForwardCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CollectionForwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseNoRecourse" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRecourse" name="Case closed without recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_PotentialSubrogation" targetRef="Task_ObtainInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInfo" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${recoursePossible}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="Task_ClosePaid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ClosePaid" targetRef="End_PaidClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_CloseAgreed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reasoningCorrect}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_ForwardToCollectionDisagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CloseAgreed" targetRef="End_AgreedClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToCollectionDisagreement" targetRef="End_CollectionForwarded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Event_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Task_ForwardToCollectionDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToCollectionDeadline" targetRef="End_CollectionForwarded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="End_NoRecourse"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a branch that follows a decision ends with a named action performed on the subject of the process (for example, closing it) before the process ends: Model each such branch as its own task, labeled with the action the description names, placed after the decision branch and before that branch's end event. Do not replace the action with a bare end event, and do not drop it or merge it into the label of an earlier task.
rules.situation: the description states that a branch that follows a decision ends with a named action performed on the subject of the process (for example, closing it) before the process ends

rules.instruction: When the description is written in the first person by a role that performs the case work itself, and that role's own steps send requests to an external party and then depend on that party's replies, payments or objections to choose the next step: Model the performing role as its own participant pool that holds its tasks, gateways and events. Model the external party as a separate participant pool. Connect the two pools with message flows for each request the performing role sends and each reply, payment or objection the external party returns. Do not merge the external party's actions into the performing role's pool or lane.
rules.situation: the description is written in the first person by a role that performs the case work itself, and that role's own steps send requests to an external party and then depend on that party's replies, payments or objections to choose the next step

rules.instruction: When the description has the process wait for an outside party's response, and it also states a deadline or a later point in time for the process to act on, such as a deadline for disagreement after which a further step follows: Model the wait as an event-based gateway. One branch starts with a catch event for the expected response. Another branch starts with an intermediate timer catch event for the stated deadline or later point in time. Place the step that the description ties to that point (for example, forwarding the case to another party) after the timer event, so the timed path stays visible next to the response path.
rules.situation: the description has the process wait for an outside party's response, and it also states a deadline or a later point in time for the process to act on, such as a deadline for disagreement after which a further step follows

rules.instruction: When the description says one participant asks several outside parties to return a response and then picks one of those responses, and gives no steps for the outside parties beyond returning their response: Model the request and the selection as tasks in the lane of the requesting participant, in the order the description states them, with a gateway only if the outcome branches. Do not create a separate pool for the outside parties and do not add message flows to or from them. Use a separate pool with message flows only when the description gives the outside parties their own steps or treats them as independent communicating participants.
rules.situation: the description names one outside party that the performing participant only sends a single request to, and then waits on that party's returned payment or objection, while giving that party no steps of its own beyond returning that reply

rules.instruction: When the description sends a request or demand to an outside party and then states a deadline or time limit for the reply, and the flow continues on whichever comes first: the reply or the expiry of that time limit: Model the wait after the request as an event-based gateway. One branch is the event that the reply arrives. The other branch is an intermediate timer catch event for the stated time limit. Connect the timer branch to the path the description takes when the deadline passes. Do not model the deadline wait as an ordinary task.
rules.situation: the description sends a request or demand to an outside party and then states a deadline or time limit for the reply, and the flow continues on whichever comes first: the reply or the expiry of that time limit
